blocks.zh: Learning Objectives | 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 學完本節後，你將能夠：
blocks.en: After completing this section, you will be able to:

blocks.zh: 說明 TR86、TR27 與 USP <1207> 之間的關係，理解 TR86 撰寫的背景。
blocks.en: Explain the relationship among TR86, TR27 and USP <1207>, and understand the background to the writing of TR86.

blocks.zh: 描述 TR86 的三大核心內容領域，及其對現代藥品包裝的意義。
blocks.en: Describe the three core content areas of TR86 and what they mean for modern drug packaging.

blocks.zh: 將容器封閉完整性（CCI）的生命週期方法，從開發期延伸到商業生產與穩定性測試。
blocks.en: Extend the lifecycle approach to container closure integrity (CCI) from development through commercial production and stability testing.

blocks.zh: 闡述 ICH Q9 推薦的包裝完整性風險架構。
blocks.en: Explain the risk-based framework for package integrity recommended by ICH Q9.

blocks.zh: 精確定義 TR86 術語表（2.0 節）中的所有關鍵術語，並在 GMP 情境中正確運用。
blocks.en: Define precisely all key terms in the TR86 glossary (Section 2.0) and use them correctly in a GMP context.

blocks.zh: 區分確定性（deterministic）與機率性（probabilistic）洩漏測試方法。
blocks.en: Distinguish deterministic from probabilistic leak test methods.

blocks.zh: 辨別破壞性與非破壞性 CCIT 方法的差異，並說明其對樣品放行的影響。
blocks.en: Distinguish destructive from non-destructive CCIT methods and explain the implications for sample release.

blocks.zh: 解讀方法選擇中最大允許洩漏限值（MALL）與偵測極限（LOD）的概念。
blocks.en: Interpret the concepts of maximum allowable leakage limit (MALL) and limit of detection (LOD) in method selection.

blocks.zh: Document Lineage & Context | 文件沿革與背景脈絡
blocks.en: Document Lineage & Context

blocks.zh: 中文解說：文件沿革架構
blocks.en: Commentary: Document Lineage Framework

blocks.zh: 為什麼要讀 TR86？
blocks.en: Why Read TR86?

blocks.zh: TR86 是為了填補一個具體缺口而誕生的：業界在使用複雜包裝系統（如預填充針筒、大容量散裝包裝）時，現有文件（USP <1207> 及舊版 TR27）已無法充分指導。TR86 是業界共識文件，不具法規強制力，但在監管審查中具有高度參考地位。
blocks.en: TR86 was created to fill a specific gap: for industry use of complex packaging systems (such as prefilled syringes and large-volume bulk packaging), the existing documents (USP <1207> and the older TR27) no longer provide adequate guidance. TR86 is an industry consensus document. It is not legally binding, but it carries considerable weight as a reference in regulatory review.

blocks.zh: 比喻：建築法規與施工指南的關係
blocks.en: Analogy: Building Codes and Construction Guides

blocks.zh: 可以這樣理解三層文件的關係：
blocks.en: You can think of the relationship among the three layers of documents this way:

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 像建築法規——法律框架，人人必須遵守
blocks.en: ICH Q9 is like the building code: the legal framework everyone must follow

blocks.zh: USP <1207> 像標準施工規範——告訴你「怎麼蓋才合格」
blocks.en: USP <1207> is like the standard construction specification: it tells you "what counts as built to standard"

blocks.zh: TR86 像進階工程指南——專門處理「特殊結構怎麼蓋」的技術問題，例如超高層建築（大型散裝容器）或特殊地基（極低溫條件）
blocks.en: TR86 is like an advanced engineering guide: it deals specifically with technical questions of "how to build special structures", such as super-tall buildings (large bulk containers) or special foundations (extremely low temperature conditions)

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務重點
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Points

blocks.zh: 對於台灣 CDMO 而言，TR86 特別重要的原因：
blocks.en: For a Taiwan CDMO, TR86 is especially important because:

blocks.zh: 越來越多生物製劑客戶要求使用預填充針筒（PFS）系統
blocks.en: More and more biologics customers require prefilled syringe (PFS) systems

blocks.zh: FDA 483 觀察項目中，CCI 方法驗證問題持續出現
blocks.en: CCI method validation issues keep appearing among FDA 483 observations

blocks.zh: TR86 提供了 TR27 沒有覆蓋的「創新方法」技術評估框架
blocks.en: TR86 provides a technical evaluation framework for "innovative methods" that TR27 did not cover

blocks.zh: 思考問題
blocks.en: Questions to Consider

blocks.zh: USP <1207> 在 2016 年修訂的主要觸發因素是什麼文件？這說明了業界共識如何影響法規文件？
blocks.en: What document was the main trigger for the 2016 revision of USP <1207>? What does this show about how industry consensus influences regulatory documents?

blocks.zh: TR86 明確說明其內容「不代表監管機構的觀點」。這對於公司在引用 TR86 建立 SOP 時有何意涵？
blocks.en: TR86 states explicitly that its content "does not represent the views of regulatory authorities". What does this mean when your company cites TR86 to build an SOP?

blocks.zh: 你目前公司使用的哪些包裝系統可能屬於 TR86 的「複雜包裝」類別？
blocks.en: Which of the packaging systems your company currently uses might fall into TR86's "complex packaging" category?

blocks.zh: Introduction — Historical Context | 導論：歷史沿革
blocks.en: Introduction — Historical Context

blocks.zh: 中文解說：從 TR27 到 TR86 的演進
blocks.en: Commentary: The Evolution from TR27 to TR86
TR27 (1998) vs TR86 (2021): Core Differences

blocks.zh: TR27 於 1998 年出版，服務製藥界超過 20 年。其主要貢獻是建立了「包裝完整性測試最佳實踐」的基礎框架，並直接推動了 2016 年 USP <1207> 的大幅擴充。
blocks.en: TR27 was published in 1998 and served the pharmaceutical industry for more than 20 years. Its main contribution was to establish the foundational framework of "best practices for package integrity testing", and it directly drove the major expansion of USP <1207> in 2016.

blocks.zh: 然而，隨著複雜包裝系統的普及（PFS、雙倉藥筒、大容量散裝容器），TR27 的指導範圍已不足夠。TR86 的誕生，正是為了填補這個空缺。
blocks.en: However, with the spread of complex packaging systems (PFS, dual-chamber cartridges, large-volume bulk containers), the scope of TR27's guidance is no longer sufficient. TR86 was created precisely to fill this gap.

blocks.zh: 比喻：舊版地圖與新版衛星導航
blocks.en: Analogy: An Old Map and Modern Satellite Navigation

blocks.zh: TR27 就像 20 年前的紙本地圖——在平原城市非常好用，但面對山區新開發的路段就失效了。TR86 是整合了最新道路資訊的衛星導航——仍然以舊地圖的基礎知識為前提，但能處理複雜地形（複雜包裝系統）和新道路（創新測試方法）。
blocks.en: TR27 is like a paper map from 20 years ago: very useful in flat city areas, but it fails on newly built roads in the mountains. TR86 is satellite navigation that integrates the latest road information: it still builds on the foundational knowledge of the old map, but can handle complex terrain (complex packaging systems) and new roads (innovative test methods).

blocks.zh: 核心教條：「品質不能靠測試測出來」
blocks.en: Core Dogma: "Quality Cannot Be Tested into a Product"

blocks.zh: USP <1207> 明確指出：不應以「盡可能在最小缺陷尺寸下測試每個樣品」作為目標，因為 quality cannot be tested into a product。
blocks.en: USP <1207> states explicitly that the goal should not be to "test every sample at the smallest possible defect size", because quality cannot be tested into a product.

blocks.zh: 這個原則直接呼應 ICH Q10 的 QbD（品質源於設計）理念：
blocks.en: This principle echoes directly the QbD (quality by design) concept of ICH Q10:

blocks.zh: 在開發階段：用測試來理解、分析、消除風險
blocks.en: In the development phase: use testing to understand, analyze and eliminate risk

blocks.zh: 在生產/穩定性階段：用測試來監測殘餘風險、主動應對失效模式
blocks.en: In the production/stability phase: use testing to monitor residual risk and respond proactively to failure modes

blocks.zh: 這不是說測試不重要，而是說測試的目的在於理解風險，而不只是過濾不良品。
blocks.en: This does not mean testing is unimportant; it means the purpose of testing is to understand risk, not merely to screen out defective units.

blocks.zh: 為什麼沒有「單一綜合來源」？
blocks.en: Why Is There No "Single Comprehensive Source"?

blocks.zh: TR86 的起草團隊明確指出：「目前沒有任何單一來源能夠全面處理複雜包裝系統的完整性問題」。這揭示了一個產業現況：複雜包裝的挑戰是分散在不同技術文獻中的，TR86 的貢獻在於將這些知識整合成一份共識文件。
blocks.en: The TR86 drafting team states explicitly: "No single source currently addresses the integrity of complex packaging systems comprehensively". This reveals the state of the industry: the challenges of complex packaging are scattered across different technical publications, and the contribution of TR86 is to consolidate this knowledge into one consensus document.

blocks.zh: 「品質不能靠測試測出來」這句話，對你們公司目前的 CCIT 方案（如微生物侵入測試）有什麼啟示？如果只靠最終放行測試，風險在哪裡？
blocks.en: What does the statement "quality cannot be tested into a product" imply for your company's current CCIT program (such as microbial ingress testing)? If you rely only on final release testing, where is the risk?

blocks.zh: TR27 在 2000 年代仍被廣泛引用。為什麼一份業界共識文件在沒有強制法規支持下，仍能如此長期影響產業？
blocks.en: TR27 continued to be widely cited in the 2000s. Why can an industry consensus document, without mandatory regulatory backing, keep influencing the industry for so long?

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 的「哪裡可行就使用風險管理原則」——你認為在 CCIT 流程中，什麼情況下無法完全應用風險管理？
blocks.en: ICH Q9 says to apply risk management principles "wherever feasible". In your view, under what circumstances in a CCIT process can risk management not be fully applied?

blocks.zh: Introduction — Lifecycle Approach & Three Content Areas | 生命週期方法與三大主題
blocks.en: Introduction — Lifecycle Approach & Three Content Areas

blocks.zh: 中文解說：生命週期方法與三大主題
blocks.en: Commentary: The Lifecycle Approach and the Three Themes

blocks.zh: 容器封閉系統（CCS）的三大功能
blocks.en: The Three Functions of the Container Closure System (CCS)

blocks.zh: TR86 清楚區分了 CCS 的多重功能，但強調 CCIT 主要關注的是：
blocks.en: TR86 clearly distinguishes the multiple functions of a CCS, but stresses that CCIT is mainly concerned with:

blocks.zh: 首要功能：產品包容（Product Containment）——防止產品溢出或損失
blocks.en: Primary function: product containment: preventing the product from leaking out or being lost

blocks.zh: 屏障功能 1：微生物屏障——防止微生物侵入，這是無菌製品最關鍵的要求
blocks.en: Barrier function 1: microbial barrier: preventing microbial ingress, the most critical requirement for sterile products

blocks.zh: 屏障功能 2：氣體屏障——防止氧氣或水蒸氣滲入，對氧化敏感或吸濕性產品至關重要
blocks.en: Barrier function 2: gas barrier: preventing ingress of oxygen or water vapor, essential for oxidation-sensitive or hygroscopic products

blocks.zh: 功能 3：維持真空——部分凍乾產品或特殊劑型需要維持內部真空
blocks.en: Function 3: maintaining vacuum: some lyophilized products or special dosage forms need to maintain an internal vacuum

blocks.zh: 「持續進行的過程」：CCI 不是單點測試
blocks.en: "An Ongoing Process": CCI Is Not a Single-Point Test

blocks.zh: TR86 強調 package integrity testing 是貫穿產品整個生命週期的持續過程，從包裝開發開始，直到產品下市。這意味著：
blocks.en: TR86 stresses that package integrity testing is an ongoing process spanning the entire product lifecycle, from the start of packaging development until the product is withdrawn from the market. This means:

blocks.zh: 開發期：選擇設計、確立方法、建立 MALL
blocks.en: Development: select the design, establish the methods, set the MALL

blocks.zh: 驗證期：工程批次、製程確效、分析方法驗證
blocks.en: Validation: engineering batches, process validation, analytical method validation

blocks.zh: 商業生產：例行 CCIT 抽樣、製程監控
blocks.en: Commercial production: routine CCIT sampling, process monitoring

blocks.zh: 穩定性研究：確認完整性在貯存期間是否維持
blocks.en: Stability studies: confirm that integrity is maintained during storage

blocks.zh: 上市後：客訴調查、退貨分析
blocks.en: Post-marketing: complaint investigations, returned goods analysis

blocks.zh: TR86 三大主題架構
blocks.en: The Three-Theme Structure of TR86

blocks.zh:
TR86 內容架構
├── 主題 1：複雜系統挑戰
│   ├── 預填充針筒（PFS）系統
│   ├── 大容量散裝包裝
│   └── 其他複雜容器封閉系統
├── 主題 2：創新測試方法
│   ├── 現有技術的創新應用
│   ├── 極低溫條件的影響
│   └── 尚未建立 peer-reviewed 基礎的方法
└── 主題 3：額外考量事項
    ├── QbD 與包裝完整性的關係
    └── 偵測極限（LOD）的建立
blocks.en:
TR86 Content Structure
├── Theme 1: Challenges of Complex Systems
│   ├── Prefilled syringe (PFS) systems
│   ├── Large-volume bulk packaging
│   └── Other complex container closure systems
├── Theme 2: Innovative Test Methods
│   ├── Innovative applications of existing technologies
│   ├── Effects of extremely low temperature conditions
│   └── Methods without an established peer-reviewed basis
└── Theme 3: Additional Considerations
    ├── Relationship between QbD and package integrity
    └── Establishing the limit of detection (LOD)

blocks.zh: 比喻：CCI 就像汽車的安全車架設計
blocks.en: Analogy: CCI Is Like the Safety Frame Design of a Car

blocks.zh: 汽車安全車架（crumple zone）不是只在出廠前測試一次就好——它需要從設計期（CAD 模擬）到原型測試（實車碰撞）到量產監控（焊接製程 SPC），一路監控。包裝完整性也是如此：不能只靠上市前的一次驗證，而是需要貫穿整個生命週期的持續監控。
blocks.en: A car's safety frame (crumple zone) is not tested just once before leaving the factory. It is monitored all the way, from the design phase (CAD simulation) to prototype testing (real crash tests) to mass production monitoring (SPC of the welding process). Package integrity is the same: it cannot rely on a single validation before launch, but needs continuous monitoring throughout the entire lifecycle.

blocks.zh: TR86 列出三大主題中，哪一個對你目前的工作（或公司管線）最相關？為什麼？
blocks.en: Of the three themes TR86 lists, which is most relevant to your current work (or your company's pipeline)? Why?

blocks.zh: 「共識文件」與「peer-reviewed 研究」的差異在哪裡？TR86 明確承認某些創新方法尚未有 peer-reviewed 基礎，這對法規申請有何影響？
blocks.en: What is the difference between a "consensus document" and "peer-reviewed research"? TR86 explicitly acknowledges that some innovative methods do not yet have a peer-reviewed basis. What does this mean for regulatory submissions?

blocks.zh: 在穩定性研究中進行 CCIT，通常面臨哪些實際挑戰（破壞性 vs 非破壞性、樣品數量、時間點選擇等）？
blocks.en: What practical challenges are usually faced when performing CCIT in stability studies (destructive vs non-destructive methods, sample numbers, choice of time points, etc.)?

blocks.zh: QbD 概念如何應用於容器封閉系統選擇？請舉一個你熟悉的劑型為例說明。
blocks.en: How can the QbD concept be applied to the selection of a container closure system? Give an example using a dosage form you are familiar with.

blocks.zh: Introduction — Risk-Based Framework & Patient Safety | 風險架構與病人安全
blocks.en: Introduction — Risk-Based Framework & Patient Safety

blocks.zh: 中文解說：風險框架與管制要素
blocks.en: Commentary: Risk Framework and Control Elements

blocks.zh: 為何 CCI 失效是「關鍵風險」？
blocks.en: Why Is CCI Failure a "Critical Risk"?

blocks.zh: TR86 使用了非常強烈的措辭——CCI 失效被定性為 critical risk（關鍵風險），其後果鏈如下：
blocks.en: TR86 uses very strong wording: CCI failure is characterized as a critical risk, and the chain of consequences is as follows:

blocks.zh: 包裝完整性失效 → 產品受到污染
blocks.en: Package integrity failure → product becomes contaminated

blocks.zh: 污染影響產品品質 + 效力（potency）
blocks.en: Contamination affects product quality and potency

blocks.zh: 無菌靜脈注射產品受污染 → 可能導致患者嚴重傷害或死亡
blocks.en: Contaminated sterile intravenous product → may cause serious harm or death to patients

blocks.zh: 這是為什麼 FDA 在注射劑廠的審查中對 CCI 如此關注的根本原因。
blocks.en: This is the fundamental reason why FDA pays such close attention to CCI in inspections of injectable manufacturing sites.

blocks.zh: 「充分表徵且受控的製程」五要素
blocks.en: The Five Elements of a "Well-Characterized and Controlled Process"

blocks.zh: TR86 給出了一個完整製程管制的框架，包含五個核心要素：
blocks.en: TR86 gives a complete framework for process control with five core elements:

blocks.zh: 合格的容器封閉設計：CCS 的設計本身必須經過確效，包含材料相容性、封合強度等
blocks.en: Qualified container closure design: the CCS design itself must be validated, including material compatibility, seal strength, etc.

blocks.zh: 有效且受監控的製程管制：封蓋力、壓蓋速度、溫度等 CPP 必須在規格內
blocks.en: Effective and monitored process controls: CPPs such as capping force, capping speed and temperature must be within specification

blocks.zh: 進料組件規格：橡皮塞、鋁蓋、瓶體的尺寸公差、材質規格
blocks.en: Incoming component specifications: dimensional tolerances and material specifications for stoppers, aluminum seals and vials

blocks.zh: 設備確效含目視檢查系統：壓蓋機、塞瓶機的確效，加上 AVI（自動視覺檢查）
blocks.en: Equipment validation including visual inspection systems: validation of the capper and stoppering machine, plus AVI (automated visual inspection)

blocks.zh: 適當的抽樣策略：統計上有效的 CCIT 抽樣計畫
blocks.en: Appropriate sampling strategy: a statistically valid CCIT sampling plan

blocks.zh: 比喻：飛機機艙密封就是容器封閉
blocks.en: Analogy: An Aircraft Cabin Seal Is a Container Closure

blocks.zh: 飛機在 35,000 英尺高空必須維持機艙氣壓——這需要完整的密封系統。飛機公司不會只在起飛前測試一次密封：他們從機身設計開始（設計確效），到每次飛行前的例行檢查（製程管制），到定期大修（穩定性期間 CCIT）。藥品包裝的 CCI 管理邏輯完全相同。
blocks.en: An aircraft must maintain cabin pressure at 35,000 feet, which requires a complete sealing system. Airlines do not test the seals only once before takeoff: they start from the fuselage design (design validation), through routine checks before every flight (process control), to periodic major overhauls (CCIT during the stability period). The logic of managing CCI for drug packaging is exactly the same.

blocks.zh: 「產品品質是病人安全的代理指標」
blocks.en: "Product Quality Is a Surrogate for Patient Safety"

blocks.zh: TR86 的這句話點出了 GMP 的核心哲學：我們直接測量的是產品品質指標（如無菌性、效力、澄清度），這些指標是病人安全的間接（代理）指標。因此，任何影響產品品質的活動都必須進行風險評估。
blocks.en: This statement in TR86 points to the core philosophy of GMP: what we measure directly are product quality indicators (such as sterility, potency, clarity), and these are indirect (surrogate) indicators of patient safety. Therefore, any activity that affects product quality must be subject to risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 這也是為什麼 FMEA（失效模式與效應分析）在 CCS 設計和 CCIT 方法選擇中非常重要。
blocks.en: This is also why FMEA (failure mode and effects analysis) is very important in CCS design and CCIT method selection.

blocks.zh: 請列舉你公司在壓蓋製程（capping）中，目前監控的三個 CPP（關鍵製程參數）。這些參數是如何與最終 CCI 結果關聯的？
blocks.en: List three CPPs (critical process parameters) that your company currently monitors in the capping process. How are these parameters linked to the final CCI result?

blocks.zh: TR86 提到「目視檢查系統用於偵測製程異常」。目視檢查（VI）能替代 CCIT 嗎？請論述兩者的互補關係。
blocks.en: TR86 mentions that "visual inspection systems are used to detect process anomalies". Can visual inspection (VI) replace CCIT? Discuss how the two complement each other.

blocks.zh: 如果客戶（品牌藥廠）要求你的 CDMO 在穩定性研究中每個時間點對所有包裝規格都執行 CCIT，而你的實驗室只有破壞性方法，你會如何設計抽樣策略？
blocks.en: If a customer (brand-name pharmaceutical company) requires your CDMO to perform CCIT on all packaging configurations at every time point in a stability study, and your laboratory has only destructive methods, how would you design the sampling strategy?

blocks.zh: Purpose and Scope | 目的與範疇
blocks.en: Purpose and Scope

blocks.zh: 中文解說：TR86 的適用範疇與限制
blocks.en: Commentary: Scope and Limitations of TR86

blocks.zh: TR86 的三個「聚焦點」
blocks.en: The Three "Focus Points" of TR86

blocks.zh:
聚焦 1：複雜包裝系統
明確列出了針筒（syringes）、針筒組件（syringe assemblies）、散裝容器（bulk containers）——這些都是 TR27 時代尚未普及、現在卻是生物製劑主流的包裝形式
blocks.en:
Focus 1: Complex packaging systems
It explicitly lists syringes, syringe assemblies and bulk containers: packaging forms that were not yet widespread in the TR27 era but are now mainstream for biologics

blocks.zh:
聚焦 2：創新測試方法
TR86 特別強調「使用現有技術的創新方法」——不是全新發明，而是現有技術（如 HVLD、頂空分析）在新應用場景中的延伸
blocks.en:
Focus 2: Innovative test methods
TR86 particularly stresses "innovative approaches using existing technologies": not entirely new inventions, but extensions of existing technologies (such as HVLD and headspace analysis) into new application scenarios

blocks.zh:
聚焦 3：極低溫條件
這是 TR86 的獨特貢獻之一——針對 mRNA 疫苗、細胞治療等需要 -80°C 或更低溫度貯存的產品，極低溫對包裝完整性的影響
blocks.en:
Focus 3: Extremely low temperature conditions
This is one of the unique contributions of TR86: the effect of extremely low temperatures on package integrity, for products such as mRNA vaccines and cell therapies that are stored at -80°C or lower

blocks.zh: 重要聲明：非監管機構立場
blocks.en: Important Statement: Not a Regulatory Authority Position

blocks.zh: TR86 明確指出：本報告代表的是 PDA 技術團隊的共識，不代表監管機構的觀點。
blocks.en: TR86 states explicitly that this report represents the consensus of the PDA technical team and does not represent the views of regulatory authorities.

blocks.zh: 這意味著什麼？
blocks.en: What Does This Mean?

blocks.zh: TR86 的建議在 FDA 審查中具有參考地位，但不能直接作為法規要求引用
blocks.en: The recommendations of TR86 carry reference weight in FDA review, but cannot be cited directly as a regulatory requirement

blocks.zh: 如果你的方法基於 TR86 建議但尚未被 FDA 接受，你仍需要在 NDA/BLA 中提供科學論證
blocks.en: If your method is based on TR86 recommendations but has not yet been accepted by FDA, you still need to provide scientific justification in the NDA/BLA

blocks.zh: TR86 的共識是行業實踐的集體智慧，但不是監管指引
blocks.en: The consensus in TR86 is the collective wisdom of industry practice, but it is not regulatory guidance

blocks.zh: 比喻：TR86 是醫學界的「治療指引」
blocks.en: Analogy: TR86 Is the "Treatment Guideline" of the Medical World

blocks.zh: 各專科學會發布的「臨床治療指引」不是法律，但醫師如果不遵循，需要有充分的醫學理由。同樣地，TR86 不是法規要求，但如果你的 CCIT 實踐明顯偏離 TR86 建議，FDA 審查員可能會要求你解釋原因。
blocks.en: The clinical treatment guidelines issued by specialty societies are not law, but a physician who does not follow them needs sound medical reasons. Likewise, TR86 is not a regulatory requirement, but if your CCIT practice clearly deviates from the TR86 recommendations, FDA reviewers may ask you to explain why.

blocks.zh: CDMO 視角：TR86 的實際應用
blocks.en: CDMO Perspective: Practical Applications of TR86

blocks.zh: 對於台灣 CDMO 而言，TR86 最直接的應用場景：
blocks.en: For a Taiwan CDMO, the most direct application scenarios for TR86 are:

blocks.zh: 新客戶 tech transfer：評估客戶帶來的 CCIT 方法是否符合 TR86 建議
blocks.en: New customer tech transfer: assess whether the CCIT methods the customer brings are consistent with TR86 recommendations

blocks.zh: PFS 產品開發：針筒系統的 CCI 測試（needle shield integrity、backstop integrity）
blocks.en: PFS product development: CCI testing of syringe systems (needle shield integrity, backstop integrity)

blocks.zh: 凍乾粉針：橡皮塞壓入深度、西林瓶頸瓶口幾何形狀的完整性挑戰
blocks.en: Lyophilized powder for injection: integrity challenges from stopper insertion depth and vial neck/finish geometry

blocks.zh: 超低溫產品（mRNA）：需要評估冷凍/解凍循環對容器封閉系統的影響
blocks.en: Ultra-low temperature products (mRNA): the effect of freeze/thaw cycles on the container closure system needs to be assessed

blocks.zh: 你的公司目前處理的最複雜的包裝系統是什麼？它符合 TR86 定義的「複雜包裝系統」嗎？
blocks.en: What is the most complex packaging system your company currently handles? Does it meet the TR86 definition of a "complex packaging system"?

blocks.zh: 「整合了現有技術的創新方法」——你能想到哪些 CCIT 技術在近 5 年被應用於原本不是其目標的包裝系統？
blocks.en: "Innovative approaches integrating existing technologies": which CCIT technologies can you think of that have been applied in the last 5 years to packaging systems they were not originally intended for?

blocks.zh: 如果 FDA 審查員問：「你的 PFS 系統 CCIT 方案是基於什麼標準？」——你如何引用 TR86（共識文件）、USP <1207>（compendial reference）和 ICH Q9（監管指引）來回答？
blocks.en: If an FDA reviewer asks, "What standard is your PFS system CCIT program based on?", how would you cite TR86 (consensus document), USP <1207> (compendial reference) and ICH Q9 (regulatory guidance) in your answer?

blocks.zh: Glossary | 術語定義表
blocks.en: Glossary

blocks.zh: 中文解說：術語定義的重要性
blocks.en: Commentary: The Importance of Defined Terms

blocks.zh: 為何術語定義如此重要？
blocks.en: Why Are Term Definitions So Important?

blocks.zh: TR86 提醒我們：不同公司對相同術語的理解可能不一致。在 CDMO 環境中，這尤為重要：
blocks.en: TR86 reminds us that different companies may understand the same term differently. This is especially important in a CDMO environment:

blocks.zh: 客戶說的「CCI test」可能指微生物侵入測試，你理解的可能是 HVLD
blocks.en: When a customer says "CCI test", it may mean a microbial ingress test, while you may understand it as HVLD

blocks.zh: 「Probabilistic method」在不同文件中的定義範圍不同
blocks.en: The scope of "probabilistic method" is defined differently in different documents

blocks.zh: 在 SOP、驗證報告、法規申請文件中，必須使用統一且精確的術語
blocks.en: Consistent and precise terminology must be used in SOPs, validation reports and regulatory submission documents

blocks.zh: 建議：在 tech transfer 啟動會議中，主動確認客戶使用的 CCIT 術語與 TR86 定義是否一致。
blocks.en: Recommendation: at the tech transfer kickoff meeting, proactively confirm whether the CCIT terminology used by the customer is consistent with the TR86 definitions.

blocks.zh: 中文解說：關鍵術語間的邏輯關係
blocks.en: Commentary: Logical Relationships Among Key Terms

blocks.zh: MALL 與 LOD 的數學關係
blocks.en: The Mathematical Relationship Between MALL and LOD

blocks.zh:
方法選擇判斷原則：

LOD (方法偵測極限)  ≤  MALL (最大允許洩漏限值)

若 LOD > MALL → 方法不夠靈敏，不合格
若 LOD ≤ MALL → 方法可以可靠偵測所有危險洩漏

實例：
MALL = 10 μm 等效孔徑
→ 你的 CCIT 方法必須能偵測 ≤10 μm 的洩漏
→ LOD 必須 ≤10 μm
blocks.en:
Principle for method selection:

LOD (method limit of detection)  ≤  MALL (maximum allowable leakage limit)

If LOD > MALL → the method is not sensitive enough and is not acceptable
If LOD ≤ MALL → the method can reliably detect all hazardous leaks

Example:
MALL = 10 μm equivalent orifice diameter
→ Your CCIT method must be able to detect leaks ≤10 μm
→ LOD must be ≤10 μm

blocks.zh: 比喻：確定性 vs 機率性 = 溫度計 vs 看臉色
blocks.en: Analogy: Deterministic vs Probabilistic = Thermometer vs Judging by Complexion

blocks.zh: 確定性方法就像用溫度計量體溫——每次測量都給你一個客觀數字（38.5°C），可重複，可追蹤。機率性方法就像看一個人的臉色判斷是否發燒——有時看得出來，有時看不出來，取決於光線、觀察者、當時狀況。在 GMP 環境中，我們當然偏好溫度計（確定性方法）。
blocks.en: A deterministic method is like taking a temperature with a thermometer: each measurement gives you an objective number (38.5°C) that is repeatable and traceable. A probabilistic method is like judging whether someone has a fever by their complexion: sometimes you can tell and sometimes you cannot, depending on the lighting, the observer and the circumstances. In a GMP environment, we naturally prefer the thermometer (deterministic methods).

blocks.zh: 術語應用練習題
blocks.en: Practice Questions on Applying the Terms

blocks.zh: 一家公司對凍乾西林瓶使用藍色染料侵入測試（dye ingress）作為 CCIT。請判斷：這是（a）確定性還是機率性方法？（b）破壞性還是非破壞性？（c）它能否偵測氣體洩漏（如氮氣滲出）？
blocks.en: A company uses a blue dye ingress test on lyophilized vials as its CCIT. Determine: (a) is this a deterministic or probabilistic method? (b) destructive or non-destructive? (c) can it detect gas leakage (such as nitrogen escaping)?

blocks.zh: 某產品的 MALL 經科學論證為 6 μm。公司現有的 HVLD 方法 LOD 為 10 μm。請評估此方法是否符合 TR86 建議，並說明理由。
blocks.en: The MALL of a product has been scientifically justified as 6 μm. The company's existing HVLD method has an LOD of 10 μm. Assess whether this method meets the TR86 recommendations, and explain your reasoning.

blocks.zh: 「Sterile barrier 的位置」在以下包裝中分別在哪裡？（a）橡皮塞西林瓶 （b）預填充針筒（PFS）（c）安瓿瓶
blocks.en: Where is the "sterile barrier" located in each of the following packages? (a) stoppered vial (b) prefilled syringe (PFS) (c) ampoule

blocks.zh: 一個 CDMO 想將已驗證的 CCIT 方法（針對凍乾產品）應用於新的液態注射產品。從 CCS 定義和 MALL 的角度，你需要重新評估哪些要素？
blocks.en: A CDMO wants to apply a validated CCIT method (for lyophilized products) to a new liquid injectable product. From the perspective of the CCS definition and the MALL, which elements need to be reassessed?

blocks.zh: Abbreviations | 縮寫表
blocks.en: Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 中文解說：縮寫的精確使用與情境
blocks.en: Commentary: Precise Use of Abbreviations and Their Context

blocks.zh: 三組容易混淆的縮寫
blocks.en: Three Sets of Easily Confused Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 在日常工作和文件中，以下三組縮寫容易被混用，請注意區分：
blocks.en: In daily work and documents, the following three sets of abbreviations are easily used interchangeably. Be careful to distinguish them:

blocks.zh: CCI vs CCIT：CCI 是「容器封閉完整性」這個屬性；CCIT 是「測試這個屬性的方法/程序」。好比說：「我們需要確保 CCI（屬性）」vs「我們執行 CCIT（測試行為）」。
blocks.en: CCI vs CCIT: CCI is the attribute of container closure integrity; CCIT is the method/procedure for testing that attribute. For example: "We need to ensure CCI (the attribute)" vs "We perform CCIT (the testing activity)".

blocks.zh: CPP vs CQA：CPP 是製程中的關鍵參數（壓蓋力）；CQA 是產品/包裝的關鍵品質屬性（容器封閉完整性本身）。一個 CPP 的偏差可能導致 CQA 不符合。
blocks.en: CPP vs CQA: a CPP is a critical parameter in the process (capping force); a CQA is a critical quality attribute of the product/package (container closure integrity itself). A deviation in a CPP may cause the CQA to fail.

blocks.zh: MALL vs LOD：MALL 是品質標準（你的規格）；LOD 是方法能力（你的方法能偵測多小）。方法選擇的關鍵是確保 LOD ≤ MALL。
blocks.en: MALL vs LOD: MALL is the quality standard (your specification); LOD is the method capability (how small a leak your method can detect). The key to method selection is to ensure that LOD ≤ MALL.

blocks.zh: HVLD：目前最受關注的確定性 CCIT 技術
blocks.en: HVLD: Currently the Most Closely Watched Deterministic CCIT Technology

blocks.zh: 高壓放電洩漏偵測（HVLD）在近年來受到廣泛關注，原因：
blocks.en: High voltage leak detection (HVLD) has attracted wide attention in recent years, for these reasons:

blocks.zh: 非破壞性，可用於 100% 線上檢測
blocks.en: Non-destructive, and can be used for 100% inline inspection

blocks.zh: 靈敏度高，LOD 可達 2–5 μm 等效孔徑
blocks.en: High sensitivity, with an LOD of 2–5 μm equivalent orifice diameter

blocks.zh: 適用於含有導電液體的包裝（西林瓶、PFS、安瓿瓶）
blocks.en: Suitable for packages containing conductive liquids (vials, PFS, ampoules)

blocks.zh: FDA 已有多個 ANDA/NDA 案例接受 HVLD 作為 CCIT 方法
blocks.en: FDA has accepted HVLD as a CCIT method in multiple ANDA/NDA cases

blocks.zh: 限制：對凍乾產品（無導電液體）效果較差；對氣態洩漏（惰性氣體）的偵測需要特殊設定。
blocks.en: Limitations: less effective for lyophilized products (no conductive liquid); detection of gaseous leaks (inert gas) requires special setup.

blocks.zh: QbD 在 CCIT 中的應用邏輯
blocks.en: The Logic of Applying QbD in CCIT

blocks.zh: QbD（品質源於設計）應用於 CCI 的邏輯鏈：
blocks.en: The logic chain for applying QbD (quality by design) to CCI:

blocks.zh: 定義目標產品品質：需要無菌、穩定、效力維持
blocks.en: Define the target product quality: must be sterile, stable and maintain potency

blocks.zh: 識別CQA：CCI 是關鍵品質屬性
blocks.en: Identify the CQA: CCI is a critical quality attribute

blocks.zh: 建立MALL：什麼程度的洩漏會危及 CQA？
blocks.en: Establish the MALL: what level of leakage would endanger the CQA?

blocks.zh: 識別CPP：哪些製程參數影響 CCI？
blocks.en: Identify the CPPs: which process parameters affect CCI?

blocks.zh: 建立設計空間：CPP 的可接受範圍
blocks.en: Establish the design space: the acceptable range of the CPPs

blocks.zh: 選擇CCIT 方法：LOD ≤ MALL 的確定性方法
blocks.en: Select the CCIT method: a deterministic method with LOD ≤ MALL

blocks.zh: FISTA 與運輸完整性
blocks.en: FISTA and Transport Integrity

blocks.zh: FISTA（國際安全運輸協會）在 CCIT 情境中的相關性：藥品包裝不只需要在生產和貯存時維持完整性，還需要在運輸過程中承受振動、衝擊、溫度變化。FISTA 標準提供了運輸模擬測試的框架，這對評估複雜包裝系統（如含有多個元件的 PFS 組件）的運輸完整性特別重要。
blocks.en: Relevance of FISTA (International Safe Transit Association) in a CCIT context: drug packaging must maintain integrity not only during production and storage, but also withstand vibration, shock and temperature changes during transport. FISTA standards provide a framework for transport simulation testing, which is especially important for assessing the transport integrity of complex packaging systems (such as PFS assemblies with multiple components).

blocks.zh: 縮寫應用思考題
blocks.en: Abbreviation Application Questions

blocks.zh: 請寫一段完整的 CCIT 方法驗證報告的執行摘要（3-4 句），正確使用 CCI、CCIT、CCS、MALL、LOD 等縮寫，並確保每個縮寫使用情境正確。
blocks.en: Write a complete executive summary (3-4 sentences) of a CCIT method validation report, using abbreviations such as CCI, CCIT, CCS, MALL and LOD correctly, and ensure that each abbreviation is used in the right context.

blocks.zh: OES（光學發射光譜）用於頂空氣體分析——你認為這種方法更適用於偵測哪種類型的洩漏？（提示：考慮凍乾產品中的殘餘氧氣或水蒸氣洩漏 vs 液體洩漏）
blocks.en: OES (optical emission spectroscopy) is used for headspace gas analysis. Which type of leak do you think this method is better suited to detect? (Hint: consider residual oxygen or water vapor ingress in lyophilized products vs liquid leakage)

blocks.zh: 如果一個產品的 CCI 被確定為 CQA，那麼在 APQR（年度產品品質回顧）中，你應該追蹤哪些相關的 CPP 趨勢？
blocks.en: If the CCI of a product has been determined to be a CQA, which related CPP trends should you track in the APQR (annual product quality review)?

blocks.zh: 中文：縮寫決策鏈總結
blocks.en: Commentary: Summary of the Abbreviation Decision Chain

blocks.zh: CCIT 策略決策流程
blocks.en: CCIT Strategy Decision Flow

blocks.zh:
QbD 原則
    ↓
確認 CCI 是否為 CQA
    ↓
定義 CCS 的所有組件
    ↓
建立 MALL（基於微生物風險研究）
    ↓
識別影響 CCI 的 CPP
    ↓
選擇 CCIT 方法
(確認 LOD ≤ MALL)
    ↓
評估候選方法：HVLD / OES / 真空衰減 / ...
    ↓
驗證方法 → 實施 → 監控
    ↓
確保整個生命週期 CCI 維持
blocks.en:
QbD principles
    ↓
Confirm whether CCI is a CQA
    ↓
Define all components of the CCS
    ↓
Establish MALL (based on microbial risk studies)
    ↓
Identify the CPPs that affect CCI
    ↓
Select the CCIT method
(confirm LOD ≤ MALL)
    ↓
Evaluate candidate methods: HVLD / OES / vacuum decay / ...
    ↓
Validate the method → implement → monitor
    ↓
Ensure CCI is maintained throughout the lifecycle

blocks.zh: Section Summary & Key Takeaways | 本節摘要與重點總結
blocks.en: Section Summary & Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: 重點總結 — 中文
blocks.en: Key Takeaways — Commentary

blocks.zh: 文件位階：ICH Q9 → USP <1207> → TR86（進階）+ TR27（基礎）。TR86 建立在 USP <1207> 的基礎上，不是替代。
blocks.en: Document hierarchy: ICH Q9 → USP <1207> → TR86 (advanced) + TR27 (foundational). TR86 builds on USP <1207> and does not replace it.

blocks.zh: TR86 存在的原因：沒有任何單一來源能充分指導複雜包裝系統（PFS、散裝容器）或創新 CCIT 方法。TR86 以共識文件的形式填補這個缺口。
blocks.en: Why TR86 exists: no single source adequately guides complex packaging systems (PFS, bulk containers) or innovative CCIT methods. TR86 fills this gap in the form of a consensus document.

blocks.zh: 風險導向方法：「品質不能靠測試測出來。」開發期的測試應聚焦於理解和消除風險，而非僅作為放行篩選工具。
blocks.en: Risk-based approach: "Quality cannot be tested into a product." Testing in development should focus on understanding and eliminating risk, not merely serve as a release screening tool.

blocks.zh: 生命週期要求：CCI 必須貫穿整個產品生命週期——從包裝開發、商業生產到穩定性研究，全程監控。
blocks.en: Lifecycle requirement: CCI must be maintained across the entire product lifecycle, monitored throughout from packaging development and commercial production to stability studies.

blocks.zh: 確定性優於機率性：監管機構和 TR86 偏好確定性方法（定量、基於物理化學原理）而非機率性方法（隨機性、生物學基礎）。
blocks.en: Deterministic over probabilistic: regulators and TR86 prefer deterministic methods (quantitative, based on physicochemical principles) over probabilistic methods (random, biologically based).

blocks.zh: LOD 必須 ≤ MALL：方法靈敏度必須始終對應經科學風險評估建立的最大允許洩漏限值。
blocks.en: LOD must be ≤ MALL: method sensitivity must always correspond to the maximum allowable leakage limit established through scientific risk assessment.

blocks.zh: CCS 涵蓋所有組件：所有一級和二級包裝組件都是 CCS 的一部分——任何組件的變更都需要重新評估 CCI。
blocks.en: The CCS covers all components: all primary and secondary packaging components are part of the CCS; a change to any component requires reassessment of CCI.

blocks.zh: 共識非法規：TR86 代表 PDA 專家共識，不代表監管機構立場。法規申請中仍需獨立的科學論證。
blocks.en: Consensus, not regulation: TR86 represents the consensus of PDA experts, not the position of regulatory authorities. Independent scientific justification is still required in regulatory submissions.

blocks.zh: 綜合思考題（考試等級）
blocks.en: Integrated Questions (Exam Level)

blocks.zh: 請說明以下情境是否符合 TR86 的建議，並論述原因：「某 CDMO 的 QC 實驗室對所有無菌西林瓶產品使用微生物侵入測試（MIL）作為唯一的 CCIT 方法，在批次放行前執行，抽樣 AQL 2.5，每批 20 個樣品。」
blocks.en: State whether the following scenario is consistent with the TR86 recommendations, and discuss why: "The QC laboratory of a CDMO uses the microbial ingress test (MIL) as the sole CCIT method for all sterile vial products, performed before batch release, with AQL 2.5 sampling and 20 samples per batch."

blocks.zh: 一個新的 PFS 產品（含蛋白質藥物，高黏度，需要 -20°C 冷凍貯存）要求你建立 CCIT 策略。請依據 TR86 Section 0 的框架，列出你需要考慮的五個關鍵問題，並說明每個問題如何影響方法選擇。
blocks.en: A new PFS product (containing a protein drug, high viscosity, requiring frozen storage at -20°C) requires you to establish a CCIT strategy. Based on the TR86 Section 0 framework, list the five key questions you need to consider and explain how each affects method selection.

blocks.zh: TR86 說「analytical technology has progressed over the past two decades」。請列舉三種在過去 20 年中出現或顯著改進的 CCIT 技術，說明它們如何改變了包裝完整性評估的能力。
blocks.en: TR86 says "analytical technology has progressed over the past two decades". List three CCIT technologies that emerged or improved significantly over the past 20 years, and explain how they have changed the ability to assess package integrity.
